title: Fossil Free London take to the streets in protest against new North Sea oil and gas
description: PROTESTERS gathered outside the Department for Energy Security and Net Zero today to demand the government “hold the line” on its climate commitments and reject the Rosebank and Jackdaw oil fields. Campaigners from Fossil Free London tied themselves in red ribbon to emphasise how critical it is to keep the line drawn at 1.5°C and honour its legally binding promise to the Paris Climate Agreement.

title: Today’s irreverent politics ignore ancient wisdom: The need to know your limits
description: Many Americans have decried today’s politics as ‘shameless.’ The antidote, a political philosopher argues, may be more reverence – awe at just how difficult democracy is.
